Question: I am going for umrah next week, and my question is my ustaad (teacher) asked me to do one umrah for him too, does that mean i have to trim my hair to about 1 inch twice? Also im planning to do more than one umrah because ill be there for bout 4 weeks, wat should I do about my hair (i mite not have any after about 3 umarahs)?? Answer ID: 25023 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1372/1372/M=1431) Yes, when you will perform umrah on behalf of your teacher, then also you would cut your hair or shorten it after completing tawaf and sa'i. If after performing one or two umrah you have no hair on your head and you intend to offer more than one umrah, then the next time it is enough to pass razor or blade on your head. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
